conclusion: WooPayments bundles WooCommerce Subscriptions Core 6.7.1 source, but the benchmark runtime does not load WC_Subscription APIs. This artifact is therefore source-level handoff, not runtime latency coverage. The classic Subscriptions Core renewal path is still directly relevant to gateway renewals: it creates Woo renewal orders by copying subscription object data and line items, records related-order metadata, maintains related-order caches, and schedules one Action Scheduler row per subscription date event.

runtime_status.runtime_benchmark: not measured because Subscriptions Core is not active in the WordPress runtime

syntax.command: php -l selected Subscriptions Core renewal, related-order, scheduler, data copier, and datastore files copied from the running container
syntax.result: No syntax errors detected in wcs-renewal-functions.php, wcs-order-functions.php, class-wcs-action-scheduler.php, class-wcs-related-order-store-cpt.php, class-wcs-related-order-store-cached-cpt.php, and class-wc-subscriptions-data-copier.php.

entrypoints.name: Create renewal order
path: subscription->get_items( line_item, fee, shipping, tax, coupon )
foreach copied item: wc_add_order_item, new_order->get_item, wcs_copy_order_item, order_item->save
line items with products call set_backorder_meta and save again
entrypoints.performance_note: This path inherits Woo core order/order-item write amplification. It also copies subscription meta/core/operational/address/payment-token data and saves the target order before looping item copies.

entrypoints.name: Related-order lookup and cache fallback
path: if cache missing, fallback to parent::get_related_order_ids
update related-order id cache on subscription
entrypoints.performance_note: The persistent cache avoids repeated broad meta queries once warm, but a cold or deleted cache falls back to an unbounded related-order meta query and then persists the full related-order ID list.

entrypoints.name: Schedule subscription date events
path: get scheduled action hook and args
as_schedule_single_action for next_payment, trial_end, payment_retry, expiration, and end_of_prepaid_term
entrypoints.performance_note: The scheduler stores one Action Scheduler action per subscription date event. Status updates can iterate every date type and repeatedly call Action Scheduler next/unschedule/schedule APIs.

entrypoints.name: Renewal payment status transition
path: foreach related subscription: payment_complete or payment_failed
subscription status hooks and order notes
entrypoints.performance_note: A renewal status change can load related subscriptions, save the renewal order, transition subscription status, schedule/unschedule subscription actions, and add subscription order notes.

entrypoints.name: Related-order cache update hooks
path: trigger cache update hooks for tracked relation meta keys
entrypoints.performance_note: Tracking relation changes requires object meta inspection and raw meta reads around saves. This is the price of keeping the persistent related-order cache current under HPOS/CPT compatibility.

hot_path_risks.risk: Renewal order creation copies every relevant order item and saves product line items at least once, sometimes twice
hot_path_risks.evidence: wcs_create_order_from_subscription() loops subscription items, creates each order item with wc_add_order_item(), copies item data/meta, saves it, then product line items with an existing product call set_backorder_meta() and save again.
hot_path_risks.handoff: Benchmark wcs_create_renewal_order() with subscriptions containing 1, 10, 50, and 200 recurring line items under HPOS. Compare query families for wp_woocommerce_order_items, wp_woocommerce_order_itemmeta, wc_orders, wc_orders_meta, and the impact of PR #27/#28-style order item/meta improvements.

hot_path_risks.risk: Cold related-order caches fall back to unbounded meta queries
hot_path_risks.evidence: WCS_Related_Order_Store_CPT::get_related_order_ids() uses wcs_get_orders_with_meta_query() with limit=-1 and meta_query key _subscription_{relation}=subscription_id. Cached store calls this parent method when cache meta is missing.
hot_path_risks.handoff: Benchmark subscription->get_related_orders() and wcs_get_subscriptions_for_renewal_order() with cache present, cache deleted, and cache stale for subscriptions with 10/100/1k/10k related renewal orders.

hot_path_risks.risk: Related-order cache stores growing arrays of all related order IDs on the subscription
hot_path_risks.evidence: add_related_order_id_to_cache() reads the existing related-order ID list, array_unshift()s the new order id, and update_related_order_id_cache() writes the full array back to subscription metadata, with optional CPT backfill when HPOS sync is enabled.
hot_path_risks.handoff: Measure cache metadata size and write time for long-lived subscriptions. Consider whether the newest/last-order paths can avoid reading or rewriting the full historical ID list.

hot_path_risks.risk: Action Scheduler row count scales with active subscription date events
hot_path_risks.evidence: WCS_Action_Scheduler::update_date() and update_status() use as_next_scheduled_action(), as_unschedule_all_actions(), and as_schedule_single_action() for subscription next_payment, trial_end, retry, expiration, and prepaid-term events.
hot_path_risks.handoff: Seed 10k/100k/1M subscriptions with active next_payment events and measure subscription date/status update throughput plus Action Scheduler table/index behavior.

hot_path_risks.risk: Payment retry scheduling can touch related-order history
hot_path_risks.evidence: WCS_Action_Scheduler::get_action_args() calls subscription->get_last_order( 'ids', 'renewal' ) for payment_retry; source comments call this resource intensive when no retry date exists.
hot_path_risks.handoff: Benchmark failed renewal retry scheduling on subscriptions with many renewal orders, cache warm and cold.

hot_path_risks.risk: Status transitions combine relation lookups, order saves, subscription saves, notes, and scheduler updates
hot_path_risks.evidence: WC_Subscriptions_Renewal_Order::maybe_record_subscription_payment() checks renewal relation, gets subscriptions for renewal order, saves paid date, calls payment_complete/payment_failed on each subscription, and status transition adds order notes and fires scheduler hooks.
hot_path_risks.handoff: Profile gateway renewal success/failure with XHProf and SQL tracing. Split relation lookup/cache cost, renewal order save, subscription status save, order notes, and Action Scheduler operations.

minimum_runtime_fixture_needed: Subscriptions Core loaded so WC_Subscription and wcs_create_renewal_order are available
HPOS enabled with and without CPT synchronization
Subscriptions with 10, 100, 1k, and 10k historical renewal orders
Warm related-order cache, missing cache, and stale/deleted cache scenarios
Active next_payment, trial_end, payment_retry, and end date schedules in Action Scheduler
Gateway renewal success and failure flows for Stripe, PayPal, and WooPayments
